summary: Disabled-mode loopback bind is verified on darwin/linux/win32 for both an unset and an empty PANOPTICON_HOST; the emitted service command must carry exactly one --host of 127.0.0.1, so a platform default of 0.0.0.0 leaking through on linux/win32 or an empty override being passed as --host '' both fail; tmux is stubbed but the real command builder runs.
